activity_statements.statement: operates an integrated health plan and hospital system serving 12.9 million members across nine regional markets including California, Colorado, Georgia, Hawaii, Mid-Atlantic, Nevada, Northwest and Washington
employs 225,854 staff including 25,270 physicians and 78,630 nurses across 40 hospitals and 610 medical offices in its regional markets
delivers an integrated prepaid care model combining health insurance, hospital operations and physician medical groups under one organization for enrolled members
operates Kaiser Foundation Health Plan (insurance), Kaiser Foundation Hospitals and The Permanente Medical Groups as three integrated entities serving the same member population
provides primary, specialty and preventive care to members through a closed physician-group model where physicians continuously develop and refine medical practices for efficiency

name_reality_gap: Labeled Hospitals and Health Care; Kaiser Permanente is structurally unique as it simultaneously operates a health plan (insurer), hospitals and physician medical groups as an integrated system — the Hospitals label misses the insurer and physician-employer dimensions, which are 60% of the entity.
extraction_notes: Excellent fast-facts page with precise headcounts and facility counts as of June 2026. The integrated three-entity structure is a well-documented and distinctive model.
